profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that operates the Slack messaging platform among other enterprise products. The company's most recent annual filing, a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of $41,525,000,000. Its Slack website describes an AI assistant embedded directly in the Slack workspace, offering features such as channel and thread summarization, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, conversation translation, and workflow automation. The site describes Slackbot as a personal AI agent that adapts to a user's tone and voice. Slack states that customer data is not used to train large language models, that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and that the models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

Beyond Slack AI, the held facts record two additional tracked AI products: Tableau AI, which embeds Einstein-branded AI into Salesforce's business intelligence offering with natural language queries and a Trust Layer governance component, and Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce, which delivers CRM-embedded AI and autonomous agents. The site notes that Slack serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, allowing agents built on that platform to run inside Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

Salesforce's California legal exposure encompasses 187 cases in the held facts. Several third-party Model Context Protocol servers have been registered against Salesforce's platform, covering SOQL query access, Salesforce org administration, and DevOps pipeline management, reflecting an ecosystem of external integrations built around the company's data and tooling.
